title: Cow with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='28' ry='20' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <!-- body spots -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='8' ry='7' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='68' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='50' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#3b2f4a'/>

  <rect x='30' y='76' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='70' y='76' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e8e8e8'/>

  <rect x='30' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='88' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3b2f4a'/>

  <rect x='70' y='86' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#3b2f4a'/>

  <circle cx='86' cy='72' r='4' fill='#3b2f4a'/>

  <ellipse cx='52' cy='78' rx='10' ry='6' fill='#f7b8c8'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='80' r='2' fill='#e88aa5'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='80' r='2' fill='#e88aa5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='42' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#f4f4f4'/>
  <!-- head spot -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='32' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='8' cy='34' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(-30 8 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='36' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#e8e8e8' transform='rotate(25 36 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='8' cy='34' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7b8c8' transform='rotate(-30 8 34)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='36' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#f7b8c8' transform='rotate(25 36 36)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='52' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#f7b8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='11' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c96e8e'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='50' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c96e8e'/>

  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='3' fill='#3b2f4a'/>
  <circle cx='13.5' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='26.5' cy='38.5' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='16.5' cy='41.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='29.5' cy='41.5' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- sparkles around eyes -->
  <path d='M7 44 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <path d='M36 44 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 z' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <!-- horns -->
  <path d='M12 27 q0 -6 4 -7' stroke='#f0d9a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 27 q0 -6 -4 -7' stroke='#f0d9a0' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
